definitions: A type of machine learning model that transforms discrete items (like words, images, or users) into continuous vector representations (embeddings) in a lower-dimensional space.
A computational framework used to generate numerical representations of objects, capturing their semantic or contextual relationships.
examples: The embedding model was trained on a massive text corpus.
We used a pre-trained embedding model for our natural language processing task.
The quality of the embedding model significantly impacts downstream performance.
